interpretation.comparison: Targeted sampling and discriminator-view placement changed together; regular is not the old broad-emotion mix
interpretation.correlation: Only nonquiet crops with a defined waveform cosine enter the reported cosine mean
interpretation.counts: Crops can overlap; seconds and overshoot samples may count the same physical event more than once
interpretation.distinct_sources: Count source IDs, not independently verified people
interpretation.event_membership: Single recorded primary condition/event; source-level labels, not verified temporal event occupancy
interpretation.language_membership: Language labels exactly as recorded in the common evaluation metadata
interpretation.missing_categories: Unlisted event/language groups have no measured cohort; never interpret absence as zero error
interpretation.quiet: Fixed teacher-derived quiet masks; pooled RMS weights valid quiet samples
interpretation.small_cohorts: One-source groups are individual diagnostics, not population estimates
interpretation.statistics: Descriptive paired outcomes from one trajectory per arm; no test of perceptual equivalence
